names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 mai, «Sfântul Mucenic Dioscor».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Διόσκορος ο Νέος», with the rank word and the epithet left off.
The alternative form saint.gr prints in its own parenthesis on the same page: «Ο Άγιος Μάρτυς Διόσκορος (ή Διοσκορίδης) ο Νέος καταγόταν από τη Σμύρνη». Copied, not transliterated.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Dioscor»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Διόσκορος ο Νέος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and the epithet ο Νέος is the day line's. **`dates` stay absent**: the page gives no year at all, no emperor and no governor, and its head line carries none either, so nothing is inferred from the fact of a persecution. **The Greek adds what the folder lacked**: Smyrna as his birthplace and the place of his martyrdom; the rage of the idolaters against the Christians, which only kindled his zeal the more; his being denounced as a Christian; his confession that he was one and would stay unmoved in it; the throwing of him into the most wretched and dark prison in the hope that heavy imprisonment would tame his spirit; his going on declaring that to his last breath he would stay faithful to his Jesus; and his death by beheading. **A second form of the name is added**, «(ή Διοσκορίδης)», as the page's own parenthesis gives it. No relics, no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).
